---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for the MEDway platform
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "discussion"]
assignees: ''

---

## 💡 Feature Summary
A concise description of the proposed capability or enhancement.

## 🏥 Clinical or Healthcare Context
Explain how this feature benefits healthcare institutions, hospital coordinators, or regional resource utilization.

## 📐 Proposed Architectural Changes
- [ ] Smart Contract Modification (EVM state, events, gas profile)
- [ ] Autonomous Agent Update (Agent logic, decision rules, state machine)
- [ ] LLM Reasoning Enhancement (Prompts, guardrails, Pydantic schemas)
- [ ] Database Persistence & Hash-Chaining
- [ ] Frontend Dashboard & UI components

## 🛡️ Security, Privacy & Compliance Impact
- Does this feature involve clinical records or patient identifiers?
- How is the **Zero Protected Health Information (PHI) On-Chain** invariant preserved?
- Are gasless EIP-712 meta-transactions impacted?

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any wireframes, diagrams, or clinical workflow references.
